topic: Where the stable-prefix accumulator lives — measured cost of the three candidate seams (Recorder-owned / per-SSE-connection / new per-session process), the real text_delta rate, and the FromMarkdown+Render cost curve
one_line: The parse (FromMarkdown.blocks), not the render, is the quadratic: 6ms @4KiB -> 82ms @32KiB -> 409ms @128KiB -> 1.3-2.4s @256KiB, while Render.render_blocks stays 0.2-28ms. Whole-turn cumulative full-prefix cost is 2.41s for a REALISTIC 12 KiB turn (115x append-only) and 51.7s for 49 KiB (609x). Real measured claude-CLI stream-json rate is only 2.11 text_delta/s at ~94 B/delta (median gap 470ms), so a realistic turn is ~12 KiB / 61s. With append-only segments a whole 12 KiB turn costs 21ms of holder CPU => CPU stops discriminating the seams; memory, viewer multiplicity and late-joiner completeness decide.

reruns.real_delta_rate: claude -p '<1500-word prompt>' --output-format stream-json --include-partial-messages --verbose --model claude-sonnet-4-5 | python3 -u -c '<timestamp each content_block_delta/text_delta, print frames/s + gap percentiles>'

structural.forwarder_is_uncapped: chat_controller.ex:606 spawn_link, no max_heap_size, no +hmax -> its mailbox has no guard; only the conn it forwards to is capped
structural.recorder_lifetime: restart: :temporary, DynamicSupervisor RuntimeSupervisor, :via Registry unique name, idle reap 30 min (recorder.ex:32) -> exists for the WHOLE turn, from the send that started it
structural.recorder_already_accumulates_runtime_tex: recorder.ex:1046 state.runtime_text <> delta (codex/runtime lane only; cleared at :turn_started/:turn_completed)
structural.no_mid_turn_tail_endpoint: router.ex has no chat tail route; the only in-flight truth is the live SSE stream
